confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, unauthorized database querying of sensitive customer data, massive data exfiltration via DNS and HTTPS, and finally, an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap from IP 162.247.74.27.
Successful login of user_08 from the same malicious IP (162.247.74.27), which is outside their normal IP range and working hours.
Unauthorized privilege escalation where user_08 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Unauthorized database access and large-scale querying of the 'customers' table.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP port 53) to a known malicious domain.
Massive data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP port 443) totaling approximately 160MB across multiple sessions.
Attempted anti-forensics by deleting the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log).

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_08's credentials were stolen via the SQL injection or if the SQL injection was a distraction.
Verification of the exact contents of the exfiltrated data.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection techniques to likely compromise user_08's credentials, subsequently logging in from an unusual IP during off-hours. The attacker escalated privileges to DBA, queried the customer database, exfiltrated significant amounts of data via DNS and HTTPS, and attempted to hide their presence by deleting system authentication logs.
